extensions.scope: Page-scoped to src/pages/staff.astro (tokens declared on .st, not :root). The shared layout nav/footer and other hotelads.es pages are the older Tailwind slate/blue look, out of scope.

clock.purpose: Every time of day: rail clock 3.5rem, entry hour 3rem, mini-clock 1.9rem, sheet hour 1.25rem; tabular, condensed.

label.purpose: Uppercase area name beside a time only; never a kicker above a heading.

caption.purpose: Plate and phone captions below a hairline.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: CTA lift, rail active bar, clock tick, plate reveal.

motion.name: clock-tick
motion.purpose: Clock digits rise from 0.35em with 3px blur when the hour changes; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: plate-reveal
motion.purpose: Entry plates on scroll; JS-only, visible by default, off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single orange action, "Probar en vivo".

components.name: Channel Chip
components.description: Paper pill naming a channel, with a stroked line icon.

components.name: Plate
components.description: A real, anonymized product screenshot on paper with caption.
components.css: .ds-plate{margin:0;max-width:22rem;background:#fcfbf8;border:1px solid #d8d2c6;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(26,29,33,0.05),0 18px 40px -22px rgba(40,32,18,0.45);overflow:hidden}.ds-plate-img{height:9rem;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#fcfbf8 0 1.4rem,#d8d2c6 1.4rem calc(1.4rem + 1px))}.ds-plate figcaption{padding:.6rem .9rem;font-family:Archivo,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:#4b5560;border-top:1px solid #d8d2c6;letter-spacing:.01em}

components.name: Hour Rail Clock
components.description: Sticky clock showing the hour of the entry in view, with the day list below.
components.css: .ds-rail{font-family:Archivo,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;color:#1f3d52;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.35rem;width:11rem}.ds-clock{font-size:3.5rem;font-weight:800;font-stretch:70%;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#c2531b}.ds-area{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4b5560}.ds-rail ol{list-style:none;margin:1.4rem 0 0;padding:0;border-left:1px solid #d8d2c6}.ds-rail li{position:relative;padding:.3rem 0 .3rem 1rem;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:color-mix(in srgb,#1f3d52 45%,transparent);transition:color .3s ease}.ds-rail li.past{color:#4b5560}.ds-rail li.on{color:#1f3d52;font-weight:700}.ds-rail li.on::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-1px;top:.3rem;bottom:.3rem;width:2px;background:#c2531b}

narrative.overview:
The page is the portal's own world: a shift sheet pinned to a warm grey wall. Screens of the real product sit on it as paper plates with a soft lift; the text is set in marine ink; hours are the only ornament, printed large in condensed tabular numerals. The reading order is the day itself, 00:00 to 23:59, and every module appears at the hour it works.

Density is editorial, not dashboard: one idea per hour-entry, long vertical rhythm, a fine ruled line between entries like the rows of a cuadrante. Colour is almost entirely ink-on-paper; a single burnt orange marks "now" and the one action. There are no gradients as surfaces, no glass panels, no icon-grid feature cards.
keyCharacteristics: Warm grey wall, off-white paper plates, marine ink; one orange for the hour and the CTA.
Archivo variable, width axis doing the hierarchy: condensed for hours and titles, normal for reading.
Hours in tabular figures as the structural device (ruler, sticky clock, rail, closing sheet).
Real, anonymized product screenshots framed as plates; conversations built in HTML, not faked as images.
Hairline rules (1px) instead of boxes to separate the day.

rules.name: The One Hour Rule
rules.body: Orange means "this hour" or "do this". It appears on the current or active time and the CTA (plus the focus ring), nowhere else: not on headings, not on section hours at rest, not as decoration.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Every surface is `pared` or `tarjeta`; depth comes from paper, hairline and a soft shadow, never from colour fills or gradients.

rules.name: The Tabular Hour Rule
rules.body: Every time is set with tabular figures in condensed heavy Archivo, so hours align and tick without jitter.

rules.name: The Label Belongs to a Time Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text exists only as the area beside a clock or sheet hour. It never sits above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a piece of the product (screenshot, phone, device) gets the sheet lift and a `pauta` border; nothing else is lifted.

dos: **Do** put the time first: every module is introduced by the hour it happens, in condensed tabular Archivo.
**Do** keep orange to the current/active hour, the CTA and the focus ring (The One Hour Rule).
**Do** show real, anonymized product screenshots as plates (12px, `pauta` hairline, sheet lift), each with a provenance sidecar and a caption.
**Do** separate content with 1px `pauta` hairlines and use `tinta` rules only to frame the closing sheet and CTA band.
**Do** build conversations in HTML with the phone mock, and mark them as examples.
**Do** keep all motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion` with content visible by default.
donts: **Don't** use icon-grid feature cards; the day's sequence is the structure.
**Don't** use gradients as surface fills or glass panels as surfaces; the only gradient is the alpha mask that fades a cropped table.
**Don't** put uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings; tracked uppercase is only an area beside a time.
**Don't** use orange for headings, entry hours at rest, bullets or decoration.
**Don't** show real guest, employee or client-hotel data, or supplier brands, in any screenshot or mock.
**Don't** inherit the layout's slate/blue Tailwind look inside this world.
